name: Harp over open fifths
desc: Celtic folkharp in 6/8: rolling arpeggios over an open B-F# fifth drone, alternating Bm and A colors like a harper's left hand under a slow air. Tender and consonant; peak brightens into faster rolls with an octave crown.

code.full: note("<[b2 f#3 b3 d4 f#4 d4] [b2 f#3 b3 d4 f#4 d4] [a2 e3 a3 c#4 e4 c#4] [b2 f#3 b3 d4 f#4 d4]>").add(note(${root})).s("folkharp").release(1.2).clip(1.5).shape(.35).gain(${gain}).room(.4).roomsize(4).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(12)).every(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: note("<[b2 f#3 b3 d4 f#4 b4] [b2 f#3 b3 d4 f#4 b4] [a2 e3 a3 c#4 e4 a4] [b2 f#3 b3 d4 f#4 b4]>").add(note(${root})).s("folkharp").release(1).clip(1.2).shape(.4).gain(${gain}).ply("<1 1 1 2>").room(.38).roomsize(4).pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(8)).lastOf(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(4).play()
